g.text: Source: Statistics Sweden ArbStatusM, 21 counties. Our THAIE 2025 uses fixed 2022 occupational weights.
All occupations within regions; not monthly software employment. Native monthly observations; no interpolation.
Each series is rebased to its own 2022 annual mean. Dashed marker indicates 30 November 2022, not a causal design.
